source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>ei.pcie_port_map__pch() 6. Check PCIe PCH target >>>ei.injectPcieError_pch(port, errType='ce') >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie error if there is one 5. Cscript will show '0x00000001 : re (00:00) -- The PCIe sets this bit when the physical layer detects a receiver error.' pch.regs.pcieX.portY.errcorsts.show() pcieX.portY, X and Y values depend on the port used for the error injection
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Correctable Error (Intel PCH Correctable Error error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'pch|corrected|uncorrected|error'; echo __PCH_Correctable_Error; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

disposition_reason: The source provides a strong register-level signature—ERRCORSTS.RE—but leaves the physical endpoint, PCH port and X/Y hierarchy runtime-dependent. With a verified map and package contract, one bounded injection is feasible under operator control, so RPUC is appropriate and the unresolved mapping is recorded as a source conflict. test_case.test_name: Correctable Error — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject a correctable Receiver Error into the approved PCH PCIe port and prove the selected port's ERRCORSTS.RE bit asserts while host, PCH endpoint and link remain healthy and the fault indicator stays off.
required_package: Physical PCH endpoint/BDF to Cscript port and pcieX/portY map
Endpoint identity, activity and management-path dependency
ITP/CScripts build/hash and proof `ce` injects Receiver Error on this interface
Mandatory ERRCORSTS.RE plus Windows PCIe CE, link/device-health and optional BMC/UEFI oracle
Abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: The FAE maps the physical PCH-attached endpoint to the Cscript port and pcieX/portY register hierarchy, verifies device and management dependencies, performs one approved CE/Receiver-Error injection, correlates the exact bit with Windows PCIe reporting and health, then restores BIOS state without retry.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie error if there is one 5. Cscript will show '0x00000001 : re (00:00) -- The PCIe sets this bit when the physical layer detects a receiver error.' pch.regs.pcieX.portY.errcorsts.show() pcieX.portY, X and Y values depend on the port used for the error injection

expected_evidence: Owner approval and PCH endpoint/BDF/port/X/Y mapping

test_case.recovery: PCH-attached functions can be boot or management-critical. Target approval must include endpoint identity and dependency checks, not only the Cscript port number.

source_conflict.reason: The required PCH port/X/Y values are unresolved; the source does not prove generic `errType='ce'` maps to Receiver Error; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and optional management logs leave the port-specific register plus Windows event as an unstated mandatory core.
